program_name: Kraken Affiliate Program (Krak card commissions 'coming soon')
application_conditions: Two tracks: 'Direct with Kraken' (in-house, creators/KOLs; application form on the page: email, social links, target countries, Kraken Public ID; reply 'within 5 business days') and Impact (media networks, content sites, traditional affiliates; sign-up via app.impact.com campaign Kraken.brand). Terms: https://www.kraken.com/legal/affiliate-agreement (not read).
paid_action: Commissions on 'eligible activity from users who sign up via your link' — ongoing activity, 'not just their first deposit'. Products currently covered: Kraken Consumer, Kraken Pro (spot, margin, futures), Kraken DEX (up to 50%), Kraken Prop (25%). Krak (debit card) and Kraken Earn: 'Coming soon' — the card is NOT yet commissionable.
validation_conditions: Eligible activity not defined on the page; rates 'vary by product, region, and affiliate profile' and are negotiated at onboarding (rev share, CPA). Geographic restrictions mentioned generically.

commission.model_note: Revenue share up to 50% on eligible volume for exchange products; rev share or CPA negotiated per partner. No rate published for the Krak/Kraken Card (coming soon).
commission.tiers_note: 'Up to' headline rate for exchange products; the card product is listed without a rate.

payout.threshold: Not stated (in-house track pays on demand once a threshold is reached)
payout.method: In-house track: USDC to the partner's Kraken account; Impact track: fiat to a bank or USDC
payout.frequency: Monthly by default (in-house) or Impact's standard schedule

rules_note: Affiliate agreement at kraken.com/legal/affiliate-agreement not read (channel rules, brand bidding, country exclusions unknown). Contracting entity not named on the page (footer: Payward, Inc.). Partners receive 'a unique referral link and tracking pixel'.
allowed_countries_note: Not listed; the application asks which countries the affiliate targets. Card commissions not yet available in any region.

evidence.title: Kraken Affiliate Program (kraken.com/affiliate)
evidence.excerpt: 'Earn up to 50% commission' — 'Commission rates vary by product, region, and affiliate profile.' Kraken Consumer / Pro / DEX up to 50%, Prop 25%; Krak 'Crypto debit card with up to 2% cashback' and Kraken Earn: 'Coming soon'. Direct track (USDC, monthly, account manager) or Impact track (fiat). Unique referral link and tracking pixel. Terms: kraken.com/legal/affiliate-agreement.

evidence.title: Kraken Affiliate Program (support, updated 2025-12-16)
evidence.excerpt: Apply at app.impact.com/campaign-promo-signup/Kraken.brand; businesses preferred, sites/apps need pre-approval, reply within 5 business days; revenue share on spot/futures/margin fees (CPA or hybrid negotiable); paid via Impact to a bank account, visible by the 15th, paid on the 29th; card not mentioned.

notes: Official publisher programme exists but the card is explicitly 'coming soon' for commissions. Candidate for David's decision once card commissions open; no application made, nobody contacted.
